rights: You are entitled to a free copy of the FIR from the police.
A woman can only be arrested between 6 AM and 6 PM, in the presence of a woman police officer.
You have the right to remain silent and not speak without a lawyer present.
The police must inform you of the grounds of arrest immediately.

priority_actions.text: Apply for Anticipatory Bail if arrest is feared.
Lodge an FIR at the nearest police station.
Request a free copy of the FIR document.
Identify witnesses and record their contact info.

evidence_checklist: Photos/Videos of the incident or injury
Time and Date log of the events
emergency_tips: DO NOT sign any blank papers given by the police.
Ensure someone knows your location and the station name.
Note down the names and belt numbers of the officers.
If arrested, demand a medical check-up immediately.

rights: Right to be protected against marketing of hazardous goods.
Right to be informed about quality, quantity, and price.
Right to seek redressal against unfair trade practices.

priority_actions.text: Send a Formal Legal Notice to the seller.
Draft a complaint for the District Consumer Commission.
Attempt to contact customer support one last time.

evidence_checklist: Email or Chat transcripts with support
emergency_tips: Do NOT throw away the original packaging or damaged item.
Take a video of the unboxing or the malfunction.
Keep all email communication chains intact.
Check for 'Hidden Terms' in the warranty card.

rights: Every citizen has the right to request information from public authorities.
Information must be provided within 30 days.
If it concerns life or liberty, information must be provided within 48 hours.
No reason is required to be given for requesting information.

priority_actions.text: Identify the correct Public Information Officer (PIO).
Draft and submit the RTI application.
Attach the ₹10 fee (IPO or Court Fee Stamp).
Keep a photocopy/speed post receipt of your application.

evidence_checklist: Exact details of the information required
emergency_tips: Specific details are better than general queries.
Mention 'Section 7(1)' if the information is about life or liberty.
Never reveal your mobile number if you fear harassment.
Ensure you have proof of the date of submission.

rights: Right to live separately while the case is pending.
Right to claim maintenance (interim and permanent).
Right to Streedhan (gifts given during marriage).
Right to custody of minor children (usually mother for children under 5).
roadmap: Cooling-off Period (6 months - can be waived)

priority_actions.text: Consult a family lawyer for asset distribution.
Attempt mediation before filing in court.

emergency_tips: Secure your financial documents and original IDs now.
Note down instances of cruelty or harassment with dates.
Consult a lawyer before moving children out of the house.
Do NOT sign 'Wait and Watch' settlements without advice.
